name: choose the quotient digit from a table on the leading bits, using a redundant digit set
mechanism: look at only a few leading bits of the partial remainder and divisor and read the next quotient digit from a small table; because the digit set is redundant (includes negatives) a slightly wrong choice is corrected by later digits rather than by a comparison

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'SRT division' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Elementary and special functions:

requires: a digit-selection table (data) and a redundant digit set
fails_when: a wrong table entry gives systematically wrong results (the 1994 processor bug)
